question: What of linga-uprooting did the omniscient Brahma-Vishnu never hand down?
premises: therefore indeed, for by omniscient Brahma-Vishnu-and-the-rest in own teaching
inference: Omniscient ones' own teachings hand down no lingoddhara at all.
uncertainties: lingoddhara reading kept per gloss; independent verification pending
plain_english: Therefore indeed, for by omniscient Brahma-Vishnu-and-the-rest in own teaching, not handed down — linga-uprooting and the rest, anything.
